data.name: Canva: Create Design
data.description: Create a new design in Canva by specifying the design type (e.g. Presentation, Poster, Logo).
data.instructions:
Create a new design in Canva.

Specify the type of design to create (e.g., Presentation, Poster, Instagram Post) and optionally a title.

**Inputs:**
- {design_type}: Type of design (e.g., "Presentation", "Poster", "Instagram Post")
- {title}: Name for the design (optional)

**Output:** {result} contains the created design details including the design ID.
